open_items: The source is the September 2023 working paper, not the journal version of record. Changes to the journal analyses or supplements are unverified.

Numbers randomized and per-arm analyzed counts are not printed. Survey enrollment is not a randomization count. Full three-arm model counts are preserved in study records and model notes; they are not substituted for unknown two-arm totals. The combined-AI correctness comparison covers all arms and uses the printed full correctness count.

The recommendation-quality analysis uses 372 participants, whereas the outside-the-frontier experiment and correctness analysis use 373. The paper gives no explanation for the missing quality observation.

Participant-level outcome SDs and usable SD-standardized effects are not reported. Printed raw coefficients and robust SEs are retained; text percentages are relative to the control mean, not standardized mean differences. No treatment means or confidence intervals were reconstructed.

Between-person similarity analyses print neither numerical arm levels nor uncertainty nor their analysis-specific participant or idea counts. Participant similarity scores share their within-arm reference pools; no uncertainty treatment is reported.

Appendix D does not identify the idea-list creativity evaluator or provide the cited results table. Its qualitative AI-access conclusion does not separate the two AI arms or establish how they were pooled; measure and all numerical statistics remain null.
The registration is described as embargoed in this version and was not inspected. Paper-primary labels do not establish preregistered-primary status.

Correctness is explicitly evaluated by human graders, but their qualifications are not separately stated. The human_raters code records the reported human grading without asserting lay or expert credentials.
Individual question-level numerical effects are available only in unlabeled plots; only the independently printed average effects are retained. No summary SE is reported.
AI-configuration comparisons print F-test p-values but no F statistics, degrees of freedom, direct AI-arm differences, or SEs of those differences.

Brand-choice correctness is retained as convergent under extraction rule 6 despite the screening form's earlier question none. These records are for study-page display and never enter pooled creativity effects.
Alternative model specifications, combined-AI summaries, and outcomes within each study reuse participants and are not independent samples.

Regression tables were also checked with find_tables; their text extraction preserves the rows even though table detection returned no tables. The raster recommendation rubric and relevant figures were inspected in memory. Every study and estimate difference in extraction/diffs/c051.json was resolved; its repeated n_total difference has one resolution. Neither extractor had an unmatched estimate, and the full-document and screening-form audit identified no additional distinct eligible contrast. All screened outcomes and contrasts are represented by estimates or not_extracted. The two studies have disjoint samples (PDF p. 10, printed p. 6), and the form identifies no shared sample with another paper. Counts, question, construct, unit, higher_is, outcome_with_ai, and within_person were independently rechecked even when A and B agreed. The unassisted assessments precede individual random assignment (PDF p. 11, printed p. 7), so all retained estimates are immediate between-person contrasts with AI available in the AI arms; there is no randomized-order paired contrast or after-AI outcome. Quality composites and tactical-action quality are usefulness, not isolated novelty; the task asks for innovative actions and Appendix B scores their business usefulness (PDF pp. 45, 47-48). Correctness is convergent. Appendix D defines participant-level between-person similarity, so its question is across_people and higher_is is more_similar, despite the misleading within-subject figure captions (PDF pp. 52-53). The study totals and full-model notes count people, not outputs, ratings, simulated sessions, or degrees of freedom. Unknown per-arm counts remain null. Text percentages and raw coefficients retain their printed values and original units, including apparent rounding inconsistencies. Source quotes preserve printed precision; JSON numbers may omit trailing zeros. All retained alternative specifications and summaries share their respective study samples. No means, SDs, intervals, standardized effects, or arm counts were computed. No newer paper, posted data, or preregistration was retrieved. Only extraction/c051.json was written.
